parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The sorting mode of function versions. Valid values: BACKWARD and FORWARD.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of function versions that are returned.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc list-function-versions --function-name my-func --next-token MTIzNCNhYmM= --direction BACKWARD --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
